stem: A retail collaborating pharmacist issues an authorized Schedule VI prescription for a referred diagnosis. Select all supported duties.

choices.text: Keep the prescription within the diagnosis and agreement scope.
Add Schedule II refills to the same prescription.
Send a copy of the prescription to the supervising physician within 24 hours.
Delay notice until the biennial agreement renewal.
Use the authority for an unrelated walk-in diagnosis.
